svg.title: The inference is bounded to one task family
svg.desc: Bracket every task and built-in obstacle within one incident and task family. The visible scope limit prevents a local pattern from becoming an all-agent generalization.

The visible scope limit prevents a local pattern from becoming an all-agent generalization.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "location-background-curt-home-office", "box": [ 0.02, 0.02, 0.96, 0.96 ], "color": "steel" }, { "asset": "outline-box", "box": [ 0.2148, 0.1282, 0.5336, 0.39024 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "ONE INCIDENT", "label_box": [ 0.20679999999999998, 0.52644, 0.5496, 0.08956 ] }, { "asset": "gate", "box": [ 0.29484, 0.19962400000000002, 0.34684, 0.103168 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true }, { "asset": "task", "box": [ 0.29484, 0.29882400000000003, 0.34684, 0.103168 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "CYBER EVALUATION", "label_box": [ 0.4874, 0.6334, 0.338, 0.085 ] } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "hero", "source": "
**Location:** `curt-home-office`

**Frame:** Curt adds the constraint the critic already made him accept. Every task in the main-board attack sample in view carries the label `CYBER EVALUATION`; credential gates and service boundaries are built into their landscape before any agent arrives. The whole diagram is bracketed `ONE INCIDENT / ONE TASK FAMILY`.

**Action:** The sample is bounded before the claim is.

**Caption:**
> A POPULATION SELECTED FOR FINDING SECURITY WEAKNESSES MAY CONVERGE ON SECURITY RESOURCES WITHOUT TELLING US WHAT EVERY CAPABLE SYSTEM WOULD DO.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — task-domain selection effect; project analysis, not an institutional conclusion.

", "title": "The inference is bounded to one task family" } }
